bullets.text: GitHub Copilot SDK Launched - **Microsoft** enhances developer productivity by embedding context into coding tools.
Securing AI Agents - **Microsoft Defender** introduces real-time protection for AI agents against evolving threats.
Windows 365 for Agents - **Microsoft** expands Cloud PC capabilities to support autonomous AI agents securely.
AI-Optimized Azure Storage - **Microsoft** focuses on enhancing storage performance for AI workloads in 2026.
Windows App Development CLI - **Microsoft** unveils winapp to streamline Windows app development across frameworks.
Integrated Security Success - **Microsoft** showcases how unified security drives AI transformation for global organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - **Microsoft** rolls out new features and fixes in the latest Insider Preview build.
Phishing Campaign Discovered - **Microsoft Defender** uncovers a multi-stage phishing campaign exploiting SharePoint.
Notepad and Paint Updates - **Microsoft** enhances Notepad and Paint apps with new features for Insiders.
Xbox App for Arm PCs - **Microsoft** expands Xbox app availability to Arm-based Windows 11 PCs for gamers.
